scope_limitations: This inventory covers seven ordinary replay entrypoints; the two package-owned offline L2 fixtures live in the separate l2-wheel-fixture registry and are not source example routes.
LOCAL_REPLAY_ONLY records the tested v4 replay shell; it does not admit a provider, SimNow, sandbox, live trading, managed execution, fills, PnL, profitability, or HFT capability.
Retired direct CTP/SimNow entrypoints for 007_ctp, plus 013_1 and 013_2, retain only config-first fail-closed compatibility CLIs; their direct providers and SimNow paths are not supported.
A real runtime/config.yaml is intentionally local and ignored. config.example.yaml is a reviewed template, never a startup fallback.
